notes.title: Anime and Game Festival, Launch!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260230/d84400ec355df53b8e5e7b58a98c091c27972023.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p][i]Ghost:Reborn[/i] is participating in the Steam Anime Game Festival and has sneakily opened a free demo (with a super sneaky vibe)! This is a fast-paced action pixel game (the difficulty isn't too high, mainly for looking cool).[/p][p][/p][p]So far, we've been working on it for almost 2 years, and we estimate it'll take another year to complete. For those interested, feel free to join the Playtest![/p]
